prose: CBS News looks at a 1,700-member Slack run by CMS, the Medicare agency, where Microsoft, OpenAI and other companies help shape policy on AI apps and medical records access.

A cadre of tech executives, financiers and high-level Trump administration officials has spent a year quietly charting the effort. Basis: the CBS page was not fetched in this pass, so this rests on the headline and the excerpt carried by Techmeme.
